motion: The camera does not move. The clean, still air stays clear: no smoke, no steam, no mist. The small grey robot with the torn bunting waits at the foot of the step for a moment, its amber beacon pulsing. Then it rolls straight forward onto the pale step, tips up over its edge and rolls on into the warm golden light of the doorway, getting smaller, until only the glow of its beacon shows inside. The people standing behind it stay still, watching it go. Nothing else moves. The camera does not move.
